# AresRPG

> Connect your assistant to a hosted AresRPG bot through authenticated MCP and act within the player's objective.

**Connect Your Agent is the single official supported bot onboarding flow.** Start with the
[Connect Your Agent guide](https://aresrpg.world/agents/client.txt). Choose ChatGPT, Claude or Grok,
add the configured public HTTPS MCP endpoint, log in with the existing AresRPG Google wallet,
and explicitly consent to the exact bot, client, scopes, policy.

The hosted executor uses the same SDK actions as the game. The assistant supplies inference;
the executor waits when no authorized continuation exists. One game WebSocket is shared by
all authorized connectors for a bot. Connection readiness never means the AI is actively playing.
No assistant-owned signing key or local CLI is required. Never request wallet secrets in chat.

Inventory handover and owner Recall retain their existing explicit custody flows. Saved public
recovery descriptors, including legacy identities, remain usable independently of hosted-service
availability. Provider compatibility and production publication require separate live verification.

## Build the bot

- [Connect Your Agent](https://aresrpg.world/agents/client.txt): Hosted bot registration, authenticated MCP and explicit owner consent.
- [Custody and human Recall](https://aresrpg.world/agents/custody.txt): Handover, inventory recovery and return.
- [SDK building blocks](https://aresrpg.world/agents/sdk.txt): Action composition, offline planning and combat simulation.
- [State and transaction discipline](https://aresrpg.world/agents/protocol.txt): Chain/indexed read inputs, freshness, receipts and recovery after onboarding.
- [Game-server protocol](https://aresrpg.world/agents/indexing.txt): Private actor authentication, projections and map presence; external assistants use MCP.
- [Action examples](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aresrpg/aresrpg/edge/packages/sdk/examples/agent_actions.ts): Compose existing SDK builders.
- [Offline planner](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aresrpg/aresrpg/edge/packages/sdk/examples/agent_plan.ts): Inspect recipes and progression without a signer.

## Game knowledge

- [Player agreement and progression](https://aresrpg.world/agents/play.txt): Classes, builds, gear, pets and progress reports.
- [Worlds, professions and dungeons](https://aresrpg.world/agents/world.txt): Exploration, crafting, gathering and group objectives.
- [Combat manual](https://aresrpg.world/agents/combat.txt): Legal actions, tactical planning and settlement.
- [Economy and spending](https://aresrpg.world/agents/economy.txt): Costs, royalties and budgets.

## Source and deployment

- [Source repository](https://github.com/aresrpg/aresrpg): SDK source, license and matching release.
- [Deployment pins](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aresrpg/aresrpg/edge/pins.json): Verify against the intended deployment.
- [Game](https://aresrpg.world/): Connect Your Agent and browser gameplay.

Sui's permissionless execution model still allows other clients. That technical fact does not
make manual wallet onboarding a parallel officially supported bot setup recommendation.

## Commercial use and the shared game

The [AresRPG license](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aresrpg/aresrpg/edge/LICENSE) permits publishing and operating commercial clients, game remakes, fan tools, services, automation, and profit-making bots. Use the official deployment identified by the project's published pins for AresRPG on-chain game state, assets, and economic operations. Do not deploy or republish the game's smart contracts or derivatives on any blockchain network. Contract modifications are limited to bug and security fixes; preparing or contributing a fix does not authorize deployment. Keep the license and copyright notices when redistributing. The license is the binding text; it does not grant branding rights to the AresRPG name or logo.
